questions.prompt: Which city fell in 1453, ending the Byzantine Empire?
questions.fact: Its walls had held off attackers for a thousand years. Large cannon finally made them obsolete in under two months.

questions.prompt: Which animal has the largest brain of any living creature?
questions.fact: It weighs around 7 kilograms, roughly five times a human brain, though brain size alone is a poor guide to intelligence.

questions.prompt: Which athlete won four gold medals at the 1936 Berlin Olympics?
questions.fact: A German long jumper reportedly offered him technique advice during the competition, and the two remained friends for life.

questions.prompt: Which Indian film industry takes its name from Bombay?
questions.fact: India releases more feature films per year than any other country, by a wide margin.

questions.prompt: Which is the driest non-polar desert on Earth?
questions.fact: Some weather stations there have never recorded rainfall, and the terrain is used to test equipment bound for Mars.

questions.prompt: Which novel features the character Bigger Thomas?
options: Go Tell It on the Mountain
questions.fact: It was among the first books by a Black American author selected by the Book of the Month Club, which made it a national bestseller.

questions.prompt: In computing, where does the term bug reportedly come from?
options: A moth found in a relay
questions.fact: The moth was taped into a logbook in 1947 with the note that it was the first actual case of a bug being found.
